notes: Qube Cinema markets this as a two-part system titled "Qube Xi with Qube XP-I | 4K Integrated Media Block" (product page: qubecinema.com/products/xi; matching brochure PDF: qubecinema.com/sites/default/files/Qube_XP-I_Dual_0.pdf). The "Qube Xi" is a small Integrated Media Block (IMB) card that plugs directly into a Series-2 DLP Cinema projector; the "Qube XP-I" is the separate 2U rack-mount RAID storage/streaming server (3-8TB hot-swap RAID) that feeds content to one or more Xi IMBs over Gigabit Ethernet. Qube's only published detailed "Technical Specifications" table is explicitly titled for the Xi IMB and lists: Gigabit Ethernet RJ-45 x2, USB 2.0 x2, AES3 digital audio out (RJ-45) x2, optional Sync In/Out BNC x2, optional 3Gbps HDSDI in BNC x4, optional Linear Timecode Out BNC x1 - product photography confirms these ports are physically on the small Xi card, not the XP-I chassis. Qube does not publish a separate rear-panel port table for the XP-I server itself. The XP-I's dual redundant AC power supplies and 2U rack form factor are corroborated only by secondary trade/customs listings ("QUBE XP-I SERVER DUAL REDUNDANT POWER SUPPLIES", Zauba.com; "2U RACK MOUNT COMPUTER SERVER (QUBE XP-I)", Zauba.com) rather than Qube's own documentation, so those two AC-In ports and the rack-unit figure are lower-confidence than the rest. The XP-I server likely also has local console/KVM ports (USB, VGA/DVI) typical of rack servers, but these are unconfirmed by any source and are omitted rather than guessed. Because Qube bundles Xi+XP-I as one system without cleanly separating per-chassis I/O, the port list above should be read as "documented for the combined Xi/XP-I system" rather than strictly isolated to the XP-I box.

ports.name: AC In 1
ports.note: One of two redundant PSU inlets on the XP-I 2U server chassis; exact IEC variant (C13/C14) not published by Qube, inferred from customs/import trade records describing dual redundant PSUs.

ports.name: AC In 2
ports.note: Second redundant PSU inlet (see AC In 1).

ports.name: Gigabit Ethernet 2
ports.note: Redundant/second Gigabit Ethernet link, used to connect the XP-I server to Qube Xi Integrated Media Block(s).

ports.name: AES3 Digital Audio Out 1
ports.note: AES3 digital audio carried over RJ-45 (not Ethernet data).

ports.name: AES3 Digital Audio Out 2
ports.note: AES3 digital audio carried over RJ-45 (not Ethernet data).
